episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A factory intern's fatal injury brings Han Jung Woo and Han Geu Roo to his room, where his goals for the future and love for his parents come into view.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Jo Sang Goo moves in as Geu Roo's legal guardian and new colleague. Geu Roo searches for a mother's message in her stash of cash and bank receipts.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A suit store owner reveals a mother's longstanding wish. Sang Goo is reminded of his costly promise. The trauma cleaners arrive at a bloody crime scene.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A user manual for a device unseen at the crime scene keeps Geu Roo up at night. Sang Goo must make a loan payment by putting up either cash or his fists.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The trauma cleaners search for the loved one of a slain doctor to hand-deliver a box full of regrets, hopes and an unrealized future for two.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Sang Goo and Geu Roo try to give a proper sendoff to a doting couple who called Move to Heaven after deciding to leave the world together hand in hand.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Sang Goo begrudgingly took Kim Soo Chul under his wing 10 years ago, unaware that his mentorship would bloom into brotherhood and end in destruction.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Sang Goo is coerced into signing up for a fight in exchange for Geu Roo and the house deed. On a special day, Geu Roo leads Sang Goo down memory lane.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Matthew Green's search for his birth mother ends with a heartbreaking misunderstanding. Sang Goo sets out to enter his final fight.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Not yet ready to let Jung Woo go, Geu Roo runs away from home. As their cohabitation comes to an end, Sang Goo's qualification as a guardian is determined.
